correctness.rationale: For connected triangle-free G (n≥3), U=I∩V(G) is a clique of G, hence |U|≤2. Selected subdivision vertices are forced exactly for edges not meeting U. The U=empty case yields z^m; singleton u yields z^(m+1-d(u)) iff no leaf-neighbor (u outside support set); U={u,v} with uv edge is always dominating and yields z^(m+3-d(u)-d(v)). These families are disjoint and exhaustive, proving the full polynomial and m+n+1-|S| total. The minimum coefficient follows from Q=max_edge degree sum, with singleton equality only if d(u)=Q-2 and empty equality only Q=3. Independent maximal-independent-set brute force checked P3,C4,P5,K1,4,C5 coefficientwise. Analytic argument covers all finite connected triangle-free n≥3.
